content.short: Vertex Protocol is a cross-margined DEX unifying spot trading, perpetual futures, and a money market under a single collateral account.
content.description: Vertex Protocol is a decentralized exchange that merges spot trading, perpetual futures, and money market borrowing into one cross-margined account architecture, allowing traders to maximize capital efficiency from a single collateral pool. The platform features an orderbook-based matching engine with on-chain settlement, delivering CEX-like performance while maintaining full self-custody. Vertex has been deployed on Mantle and multiple other EVM chains, accumulating billions in cumulative trading volume since its launch in 2023.
content.meta: Vertex Protocol is a cross-margined DEX on Mantle offering spot, perpetuals, and money market in one interface. Discover Vertex on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
